name.zh: 第94屆國際刑警組織大會

summary.en: A 97-country operation against social-engineering scams ran from January to April 2026, with 5,811 arrests and about USD 293 million in illicit assets intercepted.
summary.zh: 97個國家與地區聯手打擊社交工程詐騙，2026年1至4月行動共逮捕5,811人，攔截約2.93億美元非法資產。

question.en: Why are scams so hard to stop when criminals sit in different countries from victims?
question.zh: 詐騙集團與受害者分處不同國家時，為什麼特別難防堵？

title.zh: 「塞倫蓋蒂III」重擊非洲網路犯罪

summary.en: An INTERPOL-coordinated operation from June to August 2026 led to 1,462 arrests and over USD 105 million recovered across Africa.
summary.zh: 國際刑警協調的行動於2026年6至8月在非洲逮捕1,462人，追回逾1.05億美元。

question.en: How is AI changing the way cybercriminals operate?
question.zh: AI如何改變網路犯罪者的作案方式？
